scene: You climb upward and step upside down onto the polished ceiling floor.
picture: A flat side-view along the gallery ceiling line. At far left hangs an inverted neon portrait. The Pacific Islander girl stands left of centre, feet planted firmly against the ceiling. To her right floats a suited patron with a monocle. At far right, a brass pipe sprouts a red valve wheel.
